title: ioctl_do_kdf: redundant lock-cycle on success path
notes: In ioctl_do_kdf (crypto2dev_fd.c), the goto label layout causes out_zero to be reached by two paths: (1) early exits before the mutex_lock at line 1776, which arrive unlocked and need the lock, and (2) fall-through from out_free_okm, which exits with the lock already released. The result on the normal success path is: unlock at out_free_okm, then immediately re-lock at out_zero, call inbuf_clear (no-op since inbuf was already cleared at line 1855), then unlock again. Fix: add an early return after the mutex_unlock in out_free_okm to avoid falling into out_zero on the already-unlocked paths.
